source_record.title: Embedded Software & Systems Consultant (all genders)
source_record.description:
Welcome

Are you passionate about embedded software, industrial communication, and intelligent drive systems? Then join INVENSITY. Together with our customers, we develop innovative solutions for the next generation of industrial control and drive technologies and actively drive the digital transformation of industry.

Your contribution: You’ll develop and optimize software for modern controller platforms, variable-frequency drives, and servo drives. With your expertise in real-time communication, embedded systems, and industrial networks, you’ll lay the foundation for high-performance, reliable, and future-proof automation solutions.



What can you expect?

  • Help shape the next generation of intelligent IoT solutions by developing innovative software for open communication protocols and TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking) technologies on new and existing embedded platforms
  • Bring together various technologies by integrating, validating, and continuously optimizing third-party software components and modern communication stacks
  • Work in a modern, agile development environment based on model-driven methods, which gives you the opportunity to help shape holistic solutions that go beyond individual embedded platforms
  • Take on responsibility as part of a dedicated, agile team and actively contribute to the development of high-performance, reliable, and high-quality software products
  • Benefit from collaborating in interdisciplinary and international teams, exchange ideas with experts from a wide range of disciplines, and help shape innovative technologies in a global environment
  • Personal and professional development: Grow in a technologically leading environment, build connections, and help drive innovation across a wide variety of industries


Your profile

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, communications and information technology, or a comparable field
  • Several years of professional experience in hardware-oriented embedded software development using C/C++ under real-time operating systems (RTOS), as well as in-depth knowledge of Python and Git-based development environments
  • In-depth knowledge of Ethernet-based communication protocols such as TCP/IP, TLS, and PTP; ideally supplemented by experience with industry standards such as IEEE 1588, TSN, and X.509
  • Knowledge of C#, SQL, GoogleTest, and Jenkins, as well as experience with Azure DevOps/Pipelines, Visual Studio Code, or modern CI/CD processes, is a plus
  • Strong conceptual and analytical skills, as well as the ability to communicate complex technical issues to various stakeholders in a way that is tailored to their needs, understandable, and practical
  • Business-level proficiency in German and very good English skills




What are your benefits?

  • Structured onboarding: A clear onboarding plan, joint starting days with other new employees, and dedicated contact persons will support you from day one
  • Flexible working: Permanent employment contracts, flexible working hours, the option to work from home, part-time arrangements, and sabbatical opportunities
  • Global network: Collaboration with experts across our international locations
  • A unique working atmosphere and an appreciative corporate culture: Monthly office events, a first-name culture, short communication channels, and working towards shared goals
  • A steep learning curve: Varied responsibilities in an innovative environment, with diverse projects across different industries and clients
  • Personal and professional development: Individual mentoring and coaching, ACADEMY training courses, and an open feedback culture
  • Attractive career opportunities: Transparent career paths, the opportunity to take on responsibility quickly, and international career prospects
  • Performance-based compensation package: Fixed and variable salary components as well as assessments every six months




Good to know

Employment type: Permanent employment
Work model: Hybrid, combining remote work and office-based work
Workplace: Mannheim or Heidelberg


Your contact person

Sinja Seyfert
